fires.summary: Built the first named-published-baseline conformance table for this module: 11 DSSE v1.0.2 (secure-systems-lab/dsse, 2024-05-10) normative requirements tested mechanically against the live evaluate_evidence_intake/host_receipt_valid predicate. 0/11 conformant, 8/11 divergent, 3/11 not_applicable. The predicate validates a flat 11-field self-asserted JSON receipt structurally incompatible with the DSSE envelope schema (no payload/payloadType/signatures, zero PAE computation, zero calls to any signature/trust-store/revocation primitive of its own), while a structurally conformant DSSE implementation already exists in-repo (amphora-core/src/crypto.rs) and is used by the sibling CroProtocolPackage capability in the same file but never by this predicate. Corroborates and gives spec-named structural cause for T-04's prior behavioral finding. Neither half of the claim under attack survives: not conformant, and the divergence was not previously stated against this named baseline.
